notes.title: Industry Giant returns to the big stage!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Industry Giant!

Friends of the cult classic can rejoice: Industry Giant has awakened again and is returning in a new guise!

Industry Giant 4.0 presents itself during the Steam Next Fest! The demo version is already available today for eager industrial tycoons! So don't hesitate and get the demo now!

The reinterpretation of the cult classics is looking forward to seeing old fans again and inspiring a new generation of players!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2913720/Industrie_Gigant_40_Demo/

Greetings, masters of industry!

The years have passed, the beards have grown longer, but the power is unbroken! And to keep it that way, the Industry Giant is coming back in version 4.0!

Fire up the machines, hire staff, ramp up the production lines, because things are set in motion in a not-so-distant future!
